releases.body:
Cross-process session aggregation.

Previously the annotation picker only saw sessions from the single OpenCode process that won the endpoint port — sessions running in other windows/projects were invisible. Now every OpenCode instance registers a peer server, and the endpoint owner fans out to all live peers: the picker lists every recent session across all processes and directories, and each annotation routes to the process that owns the target session. Extension contract unchanged.

List and target OpenCode sessions across all project directories and running processes.

Previously the annotation picker only showed sessions from the plugin instance's own directory (and only the process that won port 39517), so a session running in another OpenCode window/project was invisible. Now the picker lists every recent session from the shared store, biases sessions you've touched this run to the top, and can inject into any of them by id over the single loopback port.
Add extension icons and Chrome Web Store packaging (`npm run pack:ext` -> dist/extension.zip). See STORE.md for the listing kit.
Cleaner opening tag (drops redundant class/style, omits bare tags) and stronger secret redaction for input values.

Interpretation guidance moved into a bundled 'browser-annotation' skill (auto-loaded) instead of being repeated in every payload. Payload sanitized: whitespace-collapsed text, opening-tag-only HTML with secret redaction.
